errors.text_span: The chart compares four different models, dividing them into four slices.
errors.evidence: The chart displays two separate comparisons involving three unique models (GPT-4o, LLaMA, Mistral), not four models. It is structured as two concentric rings (a nested donut chart), each representing a different comparison, rather than a single chart with four slices.
The label 'GPT-4o: 19.6%' is connected by a line to the dark red segment in the inner ring, not a light blue segment.
The line from 'Mistral: 88.0%' points to a segment in the inner ring that is a very light blue/off-white color, not beige.
